children: RNS Number : 6013U  Estithmar Sukuk Limited LLC  14 September 2026

NOT FOR RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION, IN WHOLE OR IN PART, IN OR INTO OR TO ANY PERSON LOCATED OR RESIDENT IN THE UNITED STATES, ITS TERRITORIES AND POSSESSIONS (INCLUDING PUERTO RICO, THE U.S. VIRGIN ISLANDS, GUAM, AMERICAN SAMOA, WAKE ISLAND AND THE NORTHERN MARIANA ISLANDS), ANY STATE OF THE UNITED STATES OR THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA (THE "UNITED STATES") OR TO ANY U.S. PERSON (AS DEFINED BELOW) OR IN OR INTO ANY OTHER JURISDICTION WHERE IT IS UNLAWFUL TO DISTRIBUTE THIS ANNOUNCEMENT.

This announcement contains inside information as defined in Article 7 of the Market Abuse Regulation (EU) 596/2014 as it forms part of United Kingdom domestic law by virtue of the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018, as amended ("MAR"). Upon the publication of this announcement via Regulatory News Service, this inside information will be considered to be in the public domain. This announcement has been authorised for release by Mr. Ramez MHD Ruslan Alkhayyat, Vice Chairman of Estithmar Holding Q.P.S.C.
ESTITHMAR HOLDING Q.P.S.C. ANNOUNCES UPDATE IN RESPECT OF ITS EXCHANGE OFFER AND CONSENT SOLICITATION
(established in Qatar on 11 May 2008 as a Qatari limited liability company and converted to a Qatari public shareholding company on 11 May 2017)
to the holders of the following trust certificates (the "Certificateholders"):

Capitalised terms used but not otherwise defined in this announcement shall have the meanings given to them in the Exchange Offer and Consent Solicitation Memorandum dated 2 September 2026 (the "Offer Memorandum").
On 2 September 2026, Estithmar announced invitations to:

(i)            Eligible Certificateholders to offer their Existing Certificates for exchange for new Qatari Riyal denominated Certificates due 2029 (the "New Certificates") to be issued by Estithmar Sukuk Limited LLC (the "Trustee") under its QAR 3,400,000,000 Trust Certificate Issuance Programme, as updated, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions described in the Offer Memorandum (the "Exchange Offer"); and

(ii)           all Certificateholders to consent to certain modifications to the Pricing Supplements relating to the Existing Certificates by approving an Extraordinary Resolution (the "Consent Solicitation" and, together with the Exchange Offer, the "Invitation").

For the avoidance of doubt, the proposed modifications do not themselves constitute a notice of redemption of the Existing Certificates or an obligation on Estithmar to exercise any Optional Dissolution Right.

Estithmar hereby announces that the Extraordinary Resolution will be considered at the Meeting of Certificateholders to be held at 12:00 p.m. (London time) on 24 September 2026 at the offices of Simmons & Simmons LLP, CityPoint, One Ropemaker Street, London EC2Y 9SS, United Kingdom. Accordingly, no determination will be made as to whether the Extraordinary Resolution has been passed by way of Electronic Consent and, as a consequence, the Electronic Consent Deadline, the Announcement of Results of Electronic Consent and the Early Settlement Date shall no longer apply.

The Meeting will be held in accordance with the Offer Memorandum and Certificateholders will be invited to consider and, if thought fit, pass the Extraordinary Resolution at the Meeting (or any adjourned Meeting). Any valid Exchange Instructions and Voting Instructions submitted prior to the date of this announcement will remain valid and will automatically be treated as instructions for the purposes of the Meeting without any further action being required by the relevant Certificateholder. Exchange Instructions and Voting Instructions will be irrevocable except in the limited circumstances described in the Offer Memorandum.

Certificateholders may continue to submit Exchange Instructions and Voting Instructions until 4:00 pm (London time) on 21 September 2026 (the "Final Deadline") in accordance with the procedures described in the Offer Memorandum.
Save as described in this announcement, the terms of the Invitation, the Exchange Offer, the Consent Solicitation and the Proposal remain unchanged.

Certificateholders are advised to check with any bank, securities broker or other intermediary through which they hold Existing Certificates whether such intermediary would require to receive instructions to participate in the Consent Solicitation and, in the case of Eligible Certificateholders only, the Exchange Offer, before the deadlines specified above. The deadlines set by each Clearing System for the submission of Exchange Instructions by Eligible Certificateholders or Voting Instructions by Certificateholders will also be earlier than the relevant deadlines above. See "Procedures for Participating in the Exchange Offer, the Consent Solicitation and the Proposal".

A complete description of the terms and conditions of the Invitation is set out in the Offer Memorandum. A copy of the Offer Memorandum is available to Certificateholders on the Invitation Website (https://deals.is.kroll.com/estithmar), subject to registration, and can be obtained from the Exchange and Tabulation Agent.

Before making a decision with respect to the Invitation, Certificateholders should carefully consider all of the information in the Offer Memorandum and, in particular, the risk factors described in the section entitled "Risk Factors and Other Considerations Relating to the Exchange Offer, the Consent Solicitation and the Proposal" therein.
Further details about the Exchange Offer, the Consent Solicitation and the Proposal can be obtained from:
The Joint Dealer Managers and Solicitation Agents

This announcement and the Offer Memorandum do not constitute an offer or an invitation to participate in the Invitation in any jurisdiction in or from which, or to or from any person to or from whom, it is unlawful to make such offer or invitation under applicable securities laws. The distribution of the Offer Memorandum in certain jurisdictions may be restricted by law. Persons into whose possession the Offer Memorandum comes are required by each of the Trustee, Estithmar, the Delegate, the Joint Dealer Managers, the Agents and the Exchange and Tabulation Agent to inform themselves about, and to observe, any such restrictions.

[1] Comprising of QAR 500,000,000 8.75 per cent. Certificates due September 2027 (the "Tranche 1 Certificates"), the QAR 145,000,000 8.75 per cent. Certificates due September 2027 (the "Tranche 2 Certificates"), the QAR 150,000,000 8.75 per cent. Certificates due September 2027 (the "Tranche 3 Certificates") and the QAR 105,000,000 8.75 per cent. Certificates due September 2027 (the "Tranche 4 Certificates" and, together with the Tranche 1 Certificates, the Tranche 2 Certificates and the Tranche 3 Certificates, the "Existing Certificates"), each issued under the QAR 3,400,000,000 Trust Certificate Issuance Programme established by the Trustee.
